newsitem.title: USA: U.S. jobs data in line with past months -- official.
newsitem.headline: U.S. jobs data in line with past months -- official.

text.p: A U.S. Labor Department economist said Friday's July employment data were in line with a trend established over the past few months.
"These figures look very much like those we've had for several months. Never read too much into one month's figures," department economist Tom Nardone told Reuters.
The Labor Department earlier reported a drop in the July unemployment rate to 4.8 percent from 5.0 percent in June and a stronger-than-expected jump in non-farm payrolls of 316,000 in July.
